result.summary: The landlord hasn't replied to the 11 Oct approval request for a routine garden door hinge repair. I sent the landlord a reminder by email asking them to reply APPROVE, with a quote coming first if the job is bigger. I updated the tenant, said they'd hear from us by 16 Oct, and asked whether the door still locks. The ticket is on hold for 2 days. This is the first chase, so it doesn't need a human yet.

judgement.why_this_decision: Event 005 flags no reply 3 days after the landlord was emailed (event 003). Approval 12 is still pending and no spend limit is recorded. The job is a routine door/hinge repair (classifier: routine 0.98, emergency 0), so it can't go ahead without the landlord's approval. Escalation rules call for two missed follow-ups, and this is only the first. A reminder plus a hold is the proportionate step.

alternatives_considered.why_not: Only one follow-up period has passed and nothing is unsafe. The landlord can still answer, so escalating now would stall the job for no reason.
There is no approval and no pre-approved limit, and this is not an emergency.
